svg.title: Proof. Since S(x, g(x)) = 0, S(x, v) = ̄Hw with ̄H = R 1 0 H(x, g(x) + tw) dt. Every point of the segment lies in the ball of radius RV ≤RH, so each integrand and hence ̄H has counting gap at least m/2, and ⟨w, S(x, v)⟩≥(m/2)∥w∥2 2; Cauchy–Schwarz gives the first bound. The entries of ̄H obey the second-derivative scatter bound Ce−a dist, so Lemma 14.3 with M = m/2 gives ∥ ̄H−1∥∞→∞≤(4/m)Kc(b), the second bound. The chain rule gives Dxfeff= Dxf + Dvf · Dg and the last term vanishes on the graph.
